scene_summary: A dark drafting-board slab holds a large pale circular rupture, crossed by translucent lavender diagonal bands and two black horizontal bars. Thin calibration rails, purple-lit slits, taped tabs, scratches, torn edges, and small bright scars give several precise source-bearing anchors without turning the plate into cards.
